title: fix for assigning roles to control assets
body:
Supports #1802 
Well, at least it lets @ShendMikullovci specify who can control assets :-)

issues.title: Unable to move asset in the map
issues.body:
Can't seem to be able to plan out moves for the assets with any force. The bottom left panel won't appear when clicking on asset either: 

![SEA CO](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/187775226-def13bbe-6666-4075-b53c-d9b66bba716e.png)

comments.body:
We'll need something more reproducible, please @ShendMikullovci 

That could be steps within an existing wargame (easiest to reproduce) or the steps to create the simplest wargame that experiences this issue.

So this turns out to be an issue for new wargames (Test Wargame, in this example). 
However, I can't reproduce because I can't add the assets to the mapping channel: 

[5f961f40-6e5d-47a2-89b2-7ab30fb06816.webm](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/189223387-4540ce80-b767-468d-9a6c-79145195d2a4.webm)

It seems like there's a problem with editing the channel. I can only add a role through the bottom of the channel. 

At the end, assets are not clickable in the mapping.
Sure - will look at this - starting with the Game Admin issue.
Aah, the issue is with the earlier two forces.  It's them that have `all roles` controlling an asset.  Will improve error messaging.

Ok @ShendMikullovci . Found (and fixed) the error in specifying who can control assets.  It was mistakenly throwing an error when one `role` was specified.  The review versions on Heroku should be ready soon. Done!
I guess I'm not doing it right then. For some reason, I can't move them around during either phase. Could you show me how you do it?

Here is a working mapping component:
https://serge-review.herokuapp.com/storybook/?path=/story/local-mapping-smallscale--natural-earth&args=phase:planning;infoMarkers[0].position.lat:50.23249506295051;infoMarkers[0].position.lng:-19.528946616760432;infoMarkers[1].position.lat:50.24310600328171;infoMarkers[1].position.lng:-19.467288440193588;infoMarkers[2].position.lat:50.24692461728551;infoMarkers[2].position.lng:-19.570488735586327

You can select `TALN` then plan its turn. (you may have to switch to the `Blue1 - BlueCO player`, and switch Phase to `Planning`.

For the demo wargames, they may be in a state that doesn't allow planning (such as if the game isn't yet initiated).
